name: The Weave
description: The Weave is the magical network around everything. Using energy produces a brief flash in which the surrounding magic can be seen, and ley lines are dense concentrations of it.

log.summary: Elrus explains the Weave to Walker and treats it as basic knowledge Walker should already have.
